examples.title: Store-driven confirmation
examples.description: Mount Toaster once in your app. This contained demo keeps its viewport in normal flow; the default app viewport is fixed.

examples.title: Queue and expand a stack
examples.description: stack is an optional presentation of the same store. All five queued notices remain available on expansion; the measured viewport grows in normal flow.

examples.title: All variants
examples.description: The six variant names share a neutral surface. A colored icon communicates status; the original primitive exports remain usable.

examples.title: Save and undo local state
examples.description: A ToastAction has meaningful altText. The action restores the previous local workspace name.

examples.title: Update a persistent notice
examples.description: Use the existing returned id, update and dismiss handle. There is no new promise helper or loading variant.

examples.title: Controlled primitive
examples.description: The original Radix root, provider, action, close and viewport APIs remain available. open and onOpenChange belong to the parent.

examples.title: Duration and swipe direction
examples.description: providerProps preserves provider control. Per-toast duration=0 inherits the provider; Infinity keeps that notice open.
